## MCQ → Monday.com File Upload

**Webhook**: POST `/webhook/mcq-upload`

**Two paths supported**:

**Path A — Claude Code sends pre-built base64 xlsx**
```json
{
  "sessionId": "abc123",
  "itemId": "12345678",
  "studyUnitId": "SU-2796",
  "fileName": "SU-2796_mcqs_2026-03-19.xlsx",
  "file_base64": "<base64 string>"
}
```

**Path B — Agent sends MCQ JSON array**
(n8n builds CSV — no community nodes needed)
```json
{
  "sessionId": "abc123",
  "itemId": "12345678",
  "studyUnitId": "SU-2796",
  "mcqs": [ { "question_text": "...", ... } ]
}
```

## ⚠️ One-Time Setup

**Credentials needed**:
- `Monday.com API` — on Upload node + Update Status node
- Webhook bearer token — on Webhook node

**No community nodes required.**
Path B generates CSV natively (pure JS).

**IDs (do not change)**:
- Board: `18398486903`
- MCQs File col: `file_mm0vtzzb`
- Status col: `color_mm07gpke`
- Label 14 = "MCQs Ready for Review"
